method: Weighted Jaccard on the 13-category exposure vectors, excess over the random-pair baseline J0, asymmetric force-size factor across forces, per-cell mechanism adjustments with written reasons, clamps within [0.10, 0.45] and across [0.00, 0.45]; attenuation = 0.5 x (1 - mean overlap with the five other forces)

within_force_mechanism_reason.Consumer: 20 drivers with one mechanism each; the premium-hair (C-03, C-04, C-07, C-02), value (C-01, C-06, C-11, C-35) and demographic (C-05, C-25, C-18, C-34) clusters act on different P&L lines or regions; the excess is 0 and the floor of 0.10 applies without adjustment
within_force_mechanism_reason.Customer: K-01 discounters, K-12 drugstores, K-03 buyer power and K-13 retail media all compress the same European trade margin on the same LHC volume; the channels differ, so they are separate drivers, but the P&L line is one
within_force_mechanism_reason.Technology: T-11 AI agents, T-13 generative search and T-08 platform replenishment form one digital-intermediation cluster (three of six drivers); the high raw overlap also reflects category-broad exposure vectors, so the adjustment stays moderate
within_force_mechanism_reason.Government: six of ten drivers come out of one European legislative programme (microplastics, PPWR/EPR, EmpCo, EUDR/CSDDD, Detergents Regulation, UWWTD), and G-04, G-16 and G-17 stack compliance cost on the same detergent SKUs
within_force_mechanism_reason.Environmental: four COGS-side cost drivers on the same European manufactured volume; E-07 energy, E-12 oil feedstock and E-03 carbon move with the same 2026 energy shock
within_force_mechanism_reason.Competitive: four drivers with distinct actors and mechanisms (scale leaders, challengers, share windows, salon channel); the excess is 0 and the floor of 0.10 applies without adjustment

cross_force_mechanism_reason.Competitive->Technology: AI productivity (T-01) accrues to the scale leaders of X-15
